programs.title: Supertruckers 3
programs.desc: The camera will visit employees of the Kings Heavy Haulage transport company, which operates in Bristol, England.The company has existed for over forty-five years.It is difficult to transport very large, problematic goods.Each new order is a real challenge for employees.Viewers will see how giant machines, vehicles or spare parts are transported - from loading onto trucks of similar size to delivery to the destination.All goods must reach customers intact.Truck drivers are still fighting against time.

programs.title: Extreme Loggers
programs.desc: An interesting series of meetings with people performing one of the most dangerous professions in the world - lumberjacks.To pursue this profession, you must demonstrate certain character traits.You have to be tough, strong and determined.According to statistics conducted in the USA, there are 21 times more cases of death at work in this profession than in other activities.In the program, we get to know both family businesses that have been cutting down trees for years, as well as huge corporations.We watch as masters of this profession face difficult challenges in the most hostile places on earth.
